title: EmailSubmission/set args
description: Arguments for EmailSubmission/set (RFC 8621 §7.5). Creates, updates, and destroys EmailSubmission objects.

accountId.description: The account to create, update, or destroy EmailSubmission objects in.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on EmailSubmission state.

create.description: Map of creation id to EmailSubmissionCreate objects.

update.description: Map of submission id to patch objects (RFC 8620 §5.3 patch).

destroy.description: Ids of EmailSubmission objects to destroy.

onSuccessUpdateEmail.description: Map of submission id (or creation id reference) to Email patch applied on successful send.

onSuccessDestroyEmail.description: List of submission ids (or creation id references) whose associated Emails should be destroyed on successful send.
